title: Model of the exported .xlsx file (interface: Excel export, US-011)
description: A logical model of the workbook the backend writes: tests read the file back and compare it with this model (DoD-P04). Columns, in this order: the 11 predefined fields, Tags, then one column per attribute key used in the selection (keys compared ignoring case, alphabetical, spelling of the first contact in export order, D-21). Headers and country names use the language of the request. Every cell is text; a text starting with = + - or @ is written as plain text (SR-08, R-011-08). Header row bold and frozen (R-011-07). File name <group name>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.xlsx, date in Europe/Ljubljana, characters \ / : * ? " < > | and control characters replaced by _ (R-011-06, D-21).

items.description: Attribute keys after the twelfth header.
One row per ticked contact in the order of the current list sort; tags joined by comma and space, sorted by Slovenian rules (AC-011-03, D-21); no contact in Trash or of another group.
